name: Mesh Extraction from NeRF
aliases: Mesh Extraction from NeRF — Density Field Meshing, Marching Cubes on NeRF
Mesh Extraction from NeRF — Density Field Meshing, Marching Cubes on NeRF, NeRF Density Field Mesh Extraction
definition: Extracting a mesh from NeRF by volumetric sampling, thresholding density via Marching Cubes, and coloring vertices.
summary: Mesh Extraction from NeRF converts a neural radiance field into an explicit triangle mesh by applying Marching Cubes to the raw density field, distinguishing itself by avoiding learned signed distance fields.
